verdicts.ar: أثبت الناس في ابن عيينة الحميدي، وهو رئيس أصحاب ابن عيينة
verdicts.en: The firmest of all people in Ibn Uyaynah is al-Humaydi; he is the chief of Ibn Uyaynah's companions.
Al-Humaydi is, to us, an imam.

verdicts.ar: كان البخاري إذا وجد الحديث عند الحميدي لا يعدوه إلى غيره
verdicts.en: When al-Bukhari found a hadith with al-Humaydi he would not pass him over for anyone else.

bio: A Makkan scholar of the Quraysh who accompanied Sufyan ibn Uyaynah for many years and studied alongside al-Shafi'i, following him to Egypt and returning to Makkah after his death. Al-Bukhari opened his Sahih with a hadith from him.
